schedule.description: Optional schedule payload for future, daily, weekly, monthly, or custom deployment scheduling.

put.description: Rolls back a deployment in DeployHQ.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

projectId.description: The identifier or permalink of the project.

id.description: The identifier of the deployment to rollback.

mode.description: Set to preview to preview the rollback or queue to execute immediately. Defaults to queue in DeployHQ.

copyConfigFiles.description: Whether to copy config files during rollback. DeployHQ defaults this to true.

runBuildCommands.description: Whether to run build commands during rollback. DeployHQ defaults this to true.
